content: ESA - Gaia spots possible moons around hundreds of asteroids Science & Exploration Gaia spots possible moons around hundreds of asteroids 08/08/2024 9254 views 65 likes ESA / Science & Exploration / Space Science / Gaia ESA’s star-surveying Gaia mission has again proven to be a formidable asteroid explorer, spotting potential moons around more than 350 asteroids not known to have a companion. Previously, Gaia had explored asteroids known to have moons — so-called ‘binary asteroids’ — and confirmed that the telltale signs of these tiny moons show up in the telescope’s ultra-accurate astrometric data .
